description: Capture a screenshot of the garden framed on the parcel (2 m margin), in the current view mode — switch to 2d with set_view_mode for a plan view. Returns an image you can view directly.

hideZones.description: true: zones and pins hidden for this picture only — to check surfaces, objects and plants

maxSize.description: Optional: image size in pixels (default 800; larger only to read fine detail)

name: capture_preview
